limitations_and_disclaimer: These metrics evaluate detection logic against controlled, synthetic scenarios. In production SIEM environments, real-world noise, high event velocity, network address translation (NAT), and unpredictable human behavior will result in lower precision and require environment-specific baseline tuning. Do not cite benchmark test scores as guaranteed production detection rates.
